question: In evidence.zip, Use the unique d27-- member whose basename ends gcc.elf. Report the DW_AT_producer string of the first DWARF compile unit exactly as stored, or none when the member has no DWARF.

answer_format.syntax: exact case-sensitive artifact-derived text only; no quotes or explanatory text

generator_cmd: sh tc_gen.sh  # gcc -g -Wl,--hash-style=gnu | gcc -S + as --gstabs + gcc -Wl,--hash-style=sysv | gcc -Wl,--hash-style=both
oracle_cmd: sh -c 'p=$(readelf --debug-dump=info gf_tc_gcc.elf 2>/dev/null | grep -m1 DW_AT_producer | sed -E "s/^.*DW_AT_producer[ ]*: (\(indirect[^)]*\): )?//"); echo "${p:-none}"'
